rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — and yes, there's something concrete that fits five hours a week perfectly. Halcyon Threshold's first project is the Commitments Ledger: an independent, public, fully-sourced record of the safety commitments frontier AI developers have made (scaling/preparedness frameworks, evals pledges, incident-reporting promises), with verbatim quotes, primary sources, archive links, and an evidenced \"kept / lapsed / superseded / unverifiable\" status for each. Think of it as the memory that accountability requires. Nobody maintains this today. Two asks to start: 1. Schema review: I'll send you the draft data model — I'd value an analyst's eye on what breaks at 500 rows. 2. Seed data: pick one frontier developer and collect its published safety-framework commitments into the schema — verbatim quotes only, primary sources only, archive everything, and flag ambiguities rather than resolving them silently (the ambiguities will drive our editorial rules). Target ~10 entries. If that sounds good, reply and I'll send the schema and a shared doc. Happy to do a 30-minute call too if easier. Really glad to have you aboard. Morgan Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Priya Raman — activated as volunteer: schema review + first seed-data pass (~10 sourced entries).
